content: The @google/genai Node.js SDK (official googleapis/js-genai org) supports responseSchema + responseMimeType:application/json on ai.models.generateContent() to force structured JSON output, including arrays of objects via type:array/items:object schema shapes; current stable model line has moved from Gemini 2.5 to Gemini 3.x (3.1/3.5 Flash-Lite GA as of mid-2026), and gemini-2.5-flash-lite has an announced shutdown around Oct 2026.
